summary: The empirical substance is sound: ~55 numeric assertions traced, and every coefficient, SE, p-value, CI, N and economy count in the results sections matches its source result file (T2-T6, estimates.json, result.json, drop tables) exactly or within printed precision. No result or claim-contract verdict is affected by any finding. Two MAJOR items are wording/consistency defects: D1 -- the headline 'reproduces 43 of 45 quantities' does not match the comparison.csv artifact (41 of 44) and the Stage-4 audit's own .md/.json disagree with its CSV; D2 -- a sentence in S5.3 ('none reverses the sign toward the hypothesised direction') is contradicted by the +0.705 legal-rights-proxy row in the same table. Six MINOR/INFO items: an inconsistent CI critical value (D3), missing ledger tags and single-implementation interval for the Vietnam section (D4), a mislabelled 'weighted mean' (D5), loose '13 decimal places' phrasing (D6), missing secondary-outcome tables/N (D7), and an ambiguous run attribution for the logit/probit AME (D8). No manuscript number was altered by this audit.
